extName.description: The extension name, in the browser and in both stores. A product name, left untranslated.

extDescription.message: Suggerisce quali schede chiudere, organizza le altre in gruppi nativi e blocca le schede duplicate in tempo reale.
extDescription.description: The store description. Chrome Web Store allows at most 132 characters.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip on the toolbar icon, whose click opens the panel.

cmdCloseDuplicates.description: Name of the assignable keyboard shortcut, in the browser's shortcut page.

cmdToggleGuard.description: Name of the assignable keyboard shortcut, in the browser's shortcut page.

panelCounts.description: The header line that says how much is open, as in "87 tabs · 4 windows". Only the separator is translatable: both halves are already-formatted phrases.

countTabsOne.description: How many tabs are open, when there is exactly one. $1 is the formatted number.

countTabsOther.description: How many tabs are open, for every other count. $1 is the formatted number.

countWindowsOne.description: How many windows are open, when there is exactly one. $1 is the formatted number.

countWindowsOther.description: How many windows are open, for every other count. $1 is the formatted number.

navLabel.description: Accessible name of the panel's navigation bar, never shown on screen.

navDeclutter.description: Navigation tab for the view that suggests which tabs to close.

navOrganize.description: Navigation tab for the view that groups the remaining tabs.

navArchive.description: Navigation tab for the view that lists the tabs TabDeclutter closed.

navSettings.description: The gear button in the header, which opens the settings. Also its heading.

healthReview.description: How many tabs the score suggests looking at, next to the health bar. $1 is the formatted number.

declutterEmpty.message: Tutto in ordine. Nessuna scheda da rivedere.
declutterEmpty.description: Shown in the Declutter view when the score suggests nothing.

organizeEmpty.description: Shown in the Organize view when there is nothing to group.

archiveEmpty.description: Shown in the Archive view when nothing has been closed through TabDeclutter.
